results.id: R4.1 [d] the tight-turn line ends "…is later, so his rest clears."
results.saw: His rest would be short if he reported the usual 3h before take-off (Default rally before take-off), but his in-time or rally, or his B where neither is typed, is later, so his rest clears.

results.id: R4.2 [d] the "row that flies" line reads "A row that flies has its clashes and turns checked as a sortie's are, counts as a jet…"
results.saw: A shift with its B or R typed flies, every row on it; a row ticked FLIES on the Scheduler Board flies on its own. A row that flies has its clashes and turns checked as a sortie's are, counts as a jet and a sortie, and earns OIL by default. A row with nobody on it counts nothing; one that does not come in is cancelled with CX.
